text: Terminal API lets you make payments, issue refunds, collect shopper information, and run other shopper interactions on Adyen-supplied terminals
quote: The Adyen Terminal API lets you make payments, issue refunds, collect shopper information, and perform other shopper-terminal interactions using a payment terminal supplied by Adyen.

text: Terminal integration uses plain JSON messages with no libraries required
quote: This communicates using JSON messages, without the need for libraries, making integrating quicker and simpler than a traditional point-of-sale solution.

text: Integrate terminals over a local network or over the cloud to match your existing POS architecture
quote: You can integrate using the same architecture as your existing POS system, whether this communicates over a local network, or over the cloud.

text: Manage payment terminals and transactions from a unified Customer Area
quote: Lets you manage your payment terminals and transactions from our unified Customer Area.

text: Standalone terminal option for accepting in-person payments without a full API integration
quote: If you do not need a fully featured API integration, and want the quickest way to accept in-person payments, we also offer a standalone terminal solution.

text: Let shoppers pay in their local currency and offer tax-free shopping to foreign visitors
quote: Give shoppers the option to pay in their local currency, and offer tax-free shopping incentives to shoppers visiting from abroad.

text: Omnichannel shopper recognition identifies online shoppers when they buy in physical stores
quote: By using our omnichannel shopper recognition you can identify an online shopper when they make a purchase in one of your physical locations.

text: Combine in-person and online payments into a unified shopping experience
quote: Creates a unique shopping experience for your customers, that can combine your in-person and online payments.

text: Real-time data sync across all channels without additional middleware
quote: Real-time data sync across all channels No additional middleware required

text: Tap to Pay turns compatible smartphones or tablets, including iPhone, into contactless checkouts with no extra hardware
quote: Tap to Pay. Turn compatible smartphones or tablets into Tap to Pay checkouts. No extra hardware required.

text: Continue taking POS payments during temporary internet outages when offline payments are enabled
quote: When there is a temporary loss of internet connectivity, you can continue making point-of-sale payments if offline payments have been enabled.

text: Tipping can be done from the POS app, from the terminal, or on the receipt
quote: There are various ways to implement tipping ('gratuity'). These are your options: Tipping from the POS app... Tipping from the terminal... Tipping on the receipt

text: POS app can send a suggested tip that the customer accepts, changes, or declines on the terminal
quote: you add a tip amount to the payment request that you send from your POS app. The customer then accepts, changes, or declines the suggested tip amount on the payment terminal

text: Account can be configured to prompt for a tip automatically on every standalone payment
quote: We can configure your account to automatically [prompt for a tip with every standalone payment](https://docs.adyen.com/point-of-sale/standalone/standalone-use#tipping-standalone).

text: Referenced refunds plus unreferenced refunds that return any amount to any card presented at the terminal
quote: We offer two refund types: Referenced refund... Unreferenced refund... Unreferenced refunds let you return any amount to any card presented to the terminal.

text: Issue refunds from the Customer Area
quote: You can also issue refunds from your Customer Area

text: Order terminals and accessories for delivery to a chosen location via the Management API
quote: The Management API lets you order terminals and accessories for delivery to a location of your choice using API requests instead of the Customer Area.

text: Adyen test card lets you test different card brands, CVMs, and declined payments
quote: You can order an Adyen test card from your test Customer Area... Using the Adyen test card, you can: Test different card brands. Test different CVMs. Test declined payments.

text: Basic testing system simulates transaction scenarios so you can validate a test integration before going live
quote: We provide a basic testing system to simulate transaction scenarios and functionalities. You can use this system to ensure your test integration is working as expected, before you switch to an integration that can make live transactions.

text: Simulate various acquirer responses to test handling of declined transactions
quote: Simulate various acquirer responses to test your handling of declined transactions.

text: MCP server lets you use natural language with your chosen LLM client to work with Adyen's platform
quote: Our Model Context Protocol (MCP) server lets you use natural language with your chosen Large Language Model (LLM) client.

text: Webhooks deliver the final outcome of asynchronous processes, so you don't have to poll
quote: Webhooks solve this by sending you a message with the final outcome as soon as it is available.

text: Optionally receive additional transaction details in standard webhooks
quote: You can optionally receive more information about a transaction in your standard webhooks.

text: Account setting webhooks report status changes to company accounts, merchant accounts, and stores
quote: Account setting [webhooks](https://docs.adyen.com/development-resources/webhooks) inform you of status changes related to your company account, merchant accounts, and stores.

text: Customer Area keeps a log of all webhook events sent to your server
quote: In your Customer Area, you can find a log of all [webhook events](https://docs.adyen.com/development-resources/webhooks) sent to your server.

text: Verify webhook event integrity using HMAC signatures
quote: Verify the integrity of webhook events using HMAC signatures.

text: Find, diagnose, and resolve webhook delivery failures with Customer Area tools
quote: Find, diagnose, and resolve webhook delivery failures using the tools in your Customer Area.

text: Retrieve dispute information, defend or accept disputes, and upload defense documents
quote: You can retrieve dispute information, defend or accept disputes, and upload defense documents.

text: Change how you get paid for each merchant account
quote: This means you have the option to [change how you get paid](https://docs.adyen.com/account/getting-paid#change-how-you-get-paid) for each of your merchant accounts.

text: API definitions are published in OpenAPI format and can be imported into Swagger tools or Postman
quote: This repository contains Adyen API definition files, represented in the OpenAPI Specification standard

text: Full range of PCI PTS 6 certified, PCI-compliant payment terminals
quote: Get started fast with a full range of PCI PTS 6 certified terminals.

text: Terminal UI can be customized with your own branding
quote: Adyen-supplied payment terminals offer a UI that can be customized with your own branding

text: Accept global and local payment methods in person
quote: Enables you to accept global and local [payment methods](https://docs.adyen.com/point-of-sale/what-we-support/payment-methods).

text: Register a user's device to create device binding
quote: Register your user's device to create device binding.

text: Simplifies operations from terminal management through financial reconciliation
quote: Simplify everything from terminal management to financial reconciliation.
